patches.title: Targeted fix by Nemotron-3-Ultra-550b-a55b
patches.rationale: The compilation error occurs because Guava 21.0 removed the deprecated `Objects.toStringHelper()` method that was used in InventoryItem.java. The fix is to replace the Guava-based toString implementation with a standard Java implementation using StringBuilder or String.format, which eliminates the dependency on the removed method.
